info.title: Brim Sentinel API
info.description: Detect. Resolve. Settle. Explain. — AP automation and payment controls for Harborline Logistics (synthetic). All payments are SIMULATED. Demo identities (X-Demo-User-Id) are a labelled simulation, not authentication.

get.description: Identity picker source. Demo identity — not authentication.
FR-10 role-scoped Home: Needs your attention / Ready for approval / Upcoming payments.

post.description: Idempotent import of the dataset and inbox (re-running creates no duplicates).
Upload an unseen PDF/PNG invoice. Same pipeline as email intake; idempotent per (uploader, SHA-256).

get.description: Original source document (access-checked against invoice visibility).

schema.title: Response Duplicates Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Duplicates Get
Response Approval Chain Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Approvals Get

patch.description: Authorized edit → new immutable version; prior approvals invalidated; full revalidation.

post.description: Authorized, reasoned false-positive dismissal. Hard holds are not dismissible.
Record an approval/rejection bound to the current invoice version. Never releases payment.

schema.title: Response List Method Changes Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Payment Method Changes Get

post.description:
Request EFT → simulated Brim virtual card for the current invoice version. Requires vendor
card acceptance and an independently VERIFIED card route. A request is not an authorization.

Finance-manager authorization (or decline) of a method change. The authorizer must differ from
the requester, the invoice requester and the card-route registrant/verifier; on authorization the
invoice is revalidated. Never approves the invoice or releases funds.

schema.title: Response List Payments Api V1 Payments Get

post.description: Schedule a SIMULATED payment for an approved invoice (AP clerk prepares; P09).

Independent authorized release of a SIMULATED payment. All gates re-checked in one write
transaction. Same Idempotency-Key + same body → original result; different body → 409.
Record a SIMULATED settlement outcome. No funds move.

Human case actions. `request_information` returns a DRAFT message only (a person sends it).
`document_decision` (controller/CFO) can reject or keep on hold — there is no release override.
Wizard step 2: record an independent callback to a trusted contact already on file.

Wizard step 3: finance manager/controller (not the verifier) authorizes the verified route;
affected invoices are revalidated deterministically.
Wizard step 4: request approvals. This is NOT an approval or a release.

Bounded read-only investigation (≤ 8 allowlisted lookups, masked data, cited output).
AI is off by default → deterministic template. Never changes holds, cases or approvals.

schema.title: Response List Vendors Api V1 Vendors Get

post.description: Onboarding request → vendor in pending_review (held). Activation is a separate person.

Record a bank-change REQUEST. The vendor master is not changed and the new route is
UNVERIFIED; open invoices for the vendor are revalidated (and held).

schema.title: Response List Card Routes Api V1 Vendors  Vendor Id  Card Routes Get

post.description:
Register a SIMULATED Brim virtual-card route (UNVERIFIED). The merchant reference must come
from the vendor, never from a card descriptor; a different person must verify it.
Independent callback to a trusted contact on file before registration. Not the registrant.

get.description: Read-only. There is no endpoint that modifies or deletes audit events.
Recompute the hash chain (tamper-evident; not immutable without an external anchor).

schema.title: Response Verify Chain Api V1 Audit Verify Chain Get

get.description: The approval rules in force, in plain words, with what a controller/admin may change.

patch.description:
Controller/admin only. Thresholds can be made stricter, never looser than each role's authority
limit; separation-of-duties and PO rules are locked. Audited; open, not-yet-approved invoices are
re-routed under the new rules.

post.description:
Mark an approver as away with a delegate (self, or anyone for a controller/admin). Their pending
approval steps move to the delegate (P08).
Mark an approver as back. Steps that were delegated and not yet decided return to them.
